freqCoverage.tooltip: Finer-frequency data is rolled up into a coarser bucket for counting (3 months of monthly data counts as 1 quarterly; a Q4 quarterly value or a December monthly value counts as 1 annual). Conversion never happens in the opposite direction (annual → quarterly/monthly).

manualReasons.COD: Auto-collected from 2010-12 to present via the built-in time series on the BCC's new statistics site (secteur-monetaire/depots). Earlier periods aren't in this widget, so they have to be looked up year by year from Tableau 4.2 of the annual report → enter that range manually in the table below.
manualReasons.LBN: Blocked by a Cloudflare Turnstile bot challenge
manualReasons.MDG: The BFM's official page has no machine-readable FCD/TD source
manualReasons.BTN: Auto-collected from the RMA Financial Sector Performance Review quarterly reports (2012~2022-Q3). The series stopped after 2022-Q3 → enter the latest quarter manually.
manualReasons.MDA: The BNM DPMC11 Monetary Survey requires configuring a JSF/PrimeFaces report and exporting to xlsx. Set the period → Export → place report.xlsx at MDA_REPORT_XLSX or ~/Downloads/report.xlsx before collecting, or enter it manually in the table below.
manualReasons.IRQ: Auto-collected from the CBI Key Financial Indicators xlsx for 2003-12 (TD)/2004-12 (FCD) to present. 1991~2003 (June) only exists as a scanned 'Combined Historical Document' PDF that isn't machine-readable → enter only that range manually in the table below.
manualReasons.RWA: Auto-collected from 2018-06 to present via the BNR mstat API plus a probe of the last 24 months of URLs. 18 more Annual Reports (Table 3, MONETARY AGGREGATES DEVELOPMENTS, from Jun-15) are known to exist at bnr.rw/anreports, but the listing page is an Angular SPA, and even after clicking through the tabs the actual PDF download links never appear in the DOM (likely fetched via a separate API call — automation attempts failed) → if needed, find them manually by year on that page and enter them in the table below.
manualReasons.TUR: Partially auto-collected from the TCMB 'Weekly Money and Banking Statistics' PDF (including Wayback Machine snapshots). A more accurate source is the TCMB EVDS (evds2.tcmb.gov.tr) system, but it requires logging in and selecting series through the web UI to export, so it can't be automated → in EVDS, select series 1–9 (Level unit) under the 'Deposits' category, export to xlsx, then apply it with the upload button below (the 6.FOREIGN EXCHANGE DEPOSIT ACCOUNTS=FCD and 9.TOTAL=TD columns are auto-detected).
manualReasons.AGO: Automatic collection from Banco Nacional de Angola (BNA) only covers 2012-01 to present. For earlier periods, look them up manually on the BNA site and enter them in the table below: 2010~2012 under Publicações e Média > Relatórios > Boletins > Boletins Estatísticos (https://www.bna.ao/#/pt/publicacoes-e-media/relatorios/boletins/boletins-estatisticos), and 2004~2009 under Relatório Anual - Contas (https://www.bna.ao/#/pt/publicacoes-e-media/relatorios/relatorio-anual-contas).
manualReasons.LVA: Not collected (not automated). The '01 MFI balance sheet' table on statdb.bank.lv is a DevExpress ASP.NET PivotGrid (virtual scrolling, no API backend), which makes scraping effectively impossible → export one of the two pre-built tables to xlsx and apply it with the upload button below: '0104 Balance sheet in breakdown by currency' (2014-12~present; use the 'DEPOSITS (total)' row within the Euro/Foreign currency section), or the earlier archive '04 Balance sheet of MFIs (except the Bank of Latvia) (data until December 2014)' (2010-06~2014-11; its 'DEPOSITS (total)' row is a currency-blended total, so FCD is computed by summing the 'Foreign currency' leaf rows in the section below it) — both table formats are auto-detected on upload. Neither table has a residency breakdown, so FCD/TD cover all depositors, not residents only. Each re-export automatically fills in any newly available periods, so repeated uploads keep the data current.
